'''Mahreen''' was a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] native to the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] who lived sometime during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Advocate Mahreen spent several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] convincing a delegation from the [[Order of Shasa]], the protective order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] that guarded the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], to meet with her. Manaan had suffered a devastating [[Devastation of Manaan|bombardment]] by the Empire during the Great Galactic War and the native [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] had retreated into isolation within Manaan's seas. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], Mahreen&mdash;as well as mounting pressure from the Republic&mdash;convinced the Order to convert one of their few remaining surface structures into the [[Mercantile Plaza]], a trade exchange where offworlders were permitted.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mahreen was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Mercantile Plaza,<ref name="Codex" /> which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.9 on [[August 19]], [[2014]].<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb/Patch|2.9}}</ref>
